text:
Aisha Rahman: FYI — org notice: we will disable AzDO CI runners and enforce GH Actions for org builds on 2026-06-15. See short migration guide: https://go/redwood/ci-cutover.
Ben Vogel: What's the minimum change to workflows?
Aisha Rahman: Switch triggers to `on: push`/`pull_request`, replace AzDO-specific tasks with GH Action equivalents, and use `runs-on: [self-hosted, redwood-{env}]`. Example snippet in the guide.
Lena Ortiz: Secrets? We still have a few AzDO variable groups in infra repos.
Aisha Rahman: All secrets must move to Vault and sync to GH Secrets. Run `./scripts/ci-secrets-audit.sh` by 2026-05-20.
ci-bot: ACTION: `./scripts/ci-secrets-audit.sh` flags due in 7 days.
Ben Vogel: Any auth deprecations?
Aisha Rahman: PATs for CI will be revoked for org pipelines on 2026-07-01. Use GitHub Apps or OIDC. Exceptions via #help ticket.
deploy-bot: Migration plan created: azdo-decom-1856001111
